class.name: GoapPlan
class.brief_description: An ordered list of actions that reaches a [GoapGoal].
class.description: What [GoapPlanner] produces and [GoapAgent] executes: the actions to run, in order, plus a cursor tracking how far along the agent is. Plans are snapshots. They are built from the world state as it was at planning time, which is why the agent re-checks each action's preconditions before starting it and drops the plan when they no longer hold. [codeblock] func _on_plan_found(plan): var steps = [] for action in plan.actions: steps.append(action.action_name) print("%s: %s (cost %.1f)" % [plan.goal.goal_name, steps, plan.total_cost]) [/codeblock]

method.name: advance
method.description: Moves the cursor to the next action. Does nothing once the plan is finished.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the action at [param index], in execution order.

method.name: get_action_count
method.description: Returns the number of actions in the plan.

method.name: get_current_action
method.description: Returns the action the cursor points at, or [code]null[/code] if the plan is finished.

method.name: get_cursor
method.description: Returns how many actions have been completed so far.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the plan holds no actions. [method GoapPlanner.plan_for_goal] returns such a plan when the goal is already satisfied.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the cursor has passed the last action.

method.name: reset
method.description: Moves the cursor back to the first action so the plan can be run again.

members.member: The actions to run, in execution order. Assigning a new array resets the cursor.
The goal this plan was built for.
The sum of the costs of every action in the plan, as the planner evaluated them.
